comment: Most species represent proteins (kinases, transcription factors, p53 effectors) and were mapped to their common gene/protein names (TP53, ATM, ATR, CHK1/CHK2, TOPBP1, HDAC4, KEAP1, NFE2L2/NRF2, CDKN1A/p21, BAX, BBC3/PUMA, SET/I2PP2A). Omaveloxolone and spermidine are modeled drugs/compounds and were assigned as chemicals. DNA_damage and autophagy states represent processes/phenomena rather than specific molecules and were marked as unknown. The PP2A_I2PP2A species is a physical complex of PP2A and its inhibitor SET (I2PP2A) and listed both protein components. Where species denote active/inactive or modified states (e.g., _active, _inactive, _phospho, _degraded) the underlying protein identity was reported without listing the modification state as a separate name.
